headline: Sammaan Capital Limited: Timely Interest Payment on Secured Redeemable Non-Convertible Debentures
sum: Sammaan Capital Limited certified to NSE that it has made timely interest payments on its publicly issued, listed Secured Redeemable Non-Convertible Debentures (SRNCDs), in compliance with SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements (LODR) Regulation 57.
detail: Sammaan Capital Limited, a financial services company, filed an NSE intimation on 25 June 2026 certifying timely payment of interest on its publicly issued Secured Redeemable Non-Convertible Debentures listed on stock exchanges. The filing is made pursuant to SEBI LODR Regulation 57, which mandates periodic disclosure of material events, including scheduled debt servicing. The intimation does not specify the debenture series, face value, or coupon rate; these details would be found in the original public issue prospectus or the NSE/BSE listing announcement.
